Churn, the commanding general for the 200th Military Police Command, speaks to Soldiers and guests during the 200th MP Cmd’s relinquishment of command ceremony at the McGlachlin Parade Field, at Fort Meade, Md., July 10, 2016. images.filename: A U.S. Army Satellite Operations Brigade, 53rd Signal Battalion Soldier inspecting equipment at the Wideband Satellite Communications Operations Center - March 2018.jpg
images.caption: A U.S. Army Satellite Operations Brigade, 53rd Signal Battalion Soldier inspects equipment at the Wideband Satellite Communications Operations Center at Fort Meade, Maryland. images.filename: Army Reserve command holds pre-retirement briefing 170422-A-GJ885-003.jpg
images.caption: Maj. Gen. Troy D. Kok, commanding general for the U.S. Army Reserve's 99th Regional Support Command, speaks April 22 at a pre-retirement brief at Fort George G. Meade, Maryland.  The event was attended by Soldiers and spouses interested in receiving the latest information to assist in retirement preparation.  The 99th RSC periodically conducts briefings throughout its 13-state region and Europe to allow for direct assistance to multiple individuals at the same time.

images.caption: This is the basin at the end of the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal, looking north toward the end of the canal. Guard lock #8 is at the end of the channel on the left. Interstate Highway 68 / US 40 / US 220 runs on that bridge in the background. The Cumberland Masonic Temple and the Emmanuel Episcopal Church are visible to the left, beyond the highway bridge. The Western Maryland Station is just visiable (brick building, center of picture) beyond the highway bridge. Shops at Canal Place are to the right of the basin. Potomac River is to the left, just beyond the flood wall.
